headline: Kuwait Participates in the 126th Meeting of the GCC Financial and Economic Cooperation Committee
summary: Kuwait's Finance Minister met the IMF Managing Director to discuss strengthening financial and economic cooperation, during Kuwait's participation in the 126th meeting of the GCC committee.
why: The GCC financial committee coordinates fiscal and economic policy among Gulf states, influencing regional investment, budgeting and monetary coordination.
